content.text:
I fixed it: `split_cents(100, 3)` now returns `[33, 33, 34]`, so the total always adds back up. Any leftover grosze go one each to the last few people.

**I also had to change `receipt.py`, which you didn't ask for.** `receipt_lines` was working around the bug itself by adding the leftover to the last person's share. With `split_cents` fixed, keeping that workaround would have charged the leftover twice, so I deleted that one line. Receipts come out exactly as before, e.g. 10 zł split three ways is still 3,33 / 3,33 / 3,34.

**Tests:** I added a test to `test_money.py` for uneven splits, including checking that the shares add up to the total. Because I changed `receipt.py`, I also ran `test_receipt.py` alongside `test_money.py`. All 6 tests pass. Those are the only two test files I found in the repo, so if your slow full suite lives somewhere else, it hasn't been run.

Nothing is committed yet.
